hc_q8_fusions.what: hc_gate_mix_kernel for Q8_0 weights, with a variant that reads the streams in F32 and applies the sigmoid to the F32 accumulator - the unfused MMB GEMM + hc_mix_reduce, without the [hc*E, T] gate going to memory and back; the tall 384-row tile for Q8_0; the PLE conv fusion for an F32 weight
hc_q8_fusions.correction: this morning's profile read SIGMOID [10240, T] as unfused; it is hc_mix_reduce, already fused (sigmoid + mix, charged to its first node). What the gate-mix fusion removes is the gate's round trip through memory.
hc_q8_fusions.first_ubatch: GPU time 7592 -> 7245 ms (-4.6%) at depth 2.3K: hc_up GEMM 451 ms + mix 344 ms became 535 ms of fused kernel; the tall tile moved the M=320 down projection 354 -> 355 ms (nothing); the inject stays a separate F32 GEMM because Unsloth keeps it in F32 (so no down+inject packing)
